O.content: The title visibly reads "Units Sold by Product (Weekend Pop-up)".
The vertical-axis inscription visibly reads "Units Sold," with visible tick labels including "20,000" and "30,000".
A dark red bar is positioned above the visible x-axis label "Product C"; its top lies between the 20,000 and 30,000 tick heights, roughly two-fifths of the way upward from the 20,000 tick.

B.text: If the vertical axis labeled "Units Sold" is a linear upward scale and the Product C bar is bound to its x-axis label, its height can be interpolated from the 20,000 and 30,000 ticks. A value below 25,000 and less than 2,500 units from that threshold meets the stated manual-verification variance band; selecting the manual-check option assumes that this band governs when it overlaps the low-demand rule.
B.conditions: Applies to the weekend pop-up chart and Product C intake. The bar's approximate position must be sufficiently precise to establish both conditions; policy precedence for overlapping low-demand and manual-band conditions is not explicitly stated.
